firstFinding: Table clients has no row-level security. Anyone with the public key, which every visitor's browser has, can run one query and get all 212 rows. Fix: enable row-level security, add an owner policy, add a test that a user from company B can't read company A's clients.

pr.title: Lock down clients
diff: alter table clients enable row level security;
create policy "own company reads clients" on clients
for select to authenticated using (company_id = auth_company_id());
create policy "owner removes clients" on clients
for delete to authenticated using (company_id = auth_company_id() and auth_is_owner());
tests: shows no clients to a visitor who is not signed in
hides company A clients from a user of company B
shows a user only the clients of their own company
does not let a user of company B rename company A clients
does not let a user of company B add a client to company A
does not let a user of company B delete company A clients
